properties.description: Raster layers showing burned area severity computed from pre/post-event optical imagery. Include NBR, dNBR, and RBR indicators in COG format (EPSG:4326). Only pixels with RBR ≥ 0.3 are included in the overview visualization. A graded yellow-to-red (YlOrRd) color ramp highlights increasing severity in the rendered product.
